Generated HPI facts hpi-001 and hpi-002 together describe 2 days of lower central/midline abdominal pain, matching the gold fact.

Gold notes temperature 37°C; generated hpi-011 and pf-001 restate a temperature of ~37°C measured by patient.
Gold 'Feels sweaty' is captured generically by generated hpi-003 and ros-003 (hot/sweaty, subjective feverishness/sweating).

Gold specifies 'More thirsty than normal, drinking well.' Generated ros-006 and hpi-006 mention thirst/increased thirst but do not capture 'drinking well' (adequate intake). Thus the full gold content is not entirely captured.

Generated plan-004, plan-006, and fu-001 mention worsening/not improving symptoms and several specific triggers, but do not clearly include 'if temperature develops' or 'if recurrent similar symptoms' as in the gold text. Thus the exact gold follow-up instruction is not fully captured.
